in_marathi.name: Mori
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mori हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Mori is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mrituni', which means 'Goddess of death' or 'Goddess of the dead'. However, the name Mori is also associated with the Moon Goddess, Chandra, in Hindu mythology. The name is believed to bring grace, beauty, and calmness to the bearer.
